polymorphic-engine-instruction-catalogue.preconditions: Input-specific preconditions are documented by the implementation and may reject the sample.
polymorphic-engine-instruction-catalogue.invariants: Structural validity is required; complete runtime parity is not yet established for every path.
polymorphic-engine-instruction-catalogue.instructions_affected: The polymorphic engine is a state-machine composition layer. By default it applies the enabled child-pass instruction families in sequence: instruction substitution, pattern substitution, dead-code injection, block reordering, control-flow flattening, string obfuscation, and a final NoOp; optional stages add code virtualization, code mobility, and function outlining. It does not introduce a separate instruction encoding beyond the registered child passes.
polymorphic-engine-instruction-catalogue.performance: Measured by the scheduled extended maturity pass smoke: output-size, transform-duration, runtime-duration, and static metric summaries are recorded for every selected pass.
polymorphic-engine-instruction-catalogue.compatibility: A real ELF x86-64 composition matrix records successful child-pass sequencing and exit-code parity on two fixtures; arbitrary pass combinations remain unsupported.

stack-strings-instruction-catalogued.instructions_affected: Supported ELF x86-64 apply path rewrites a unique RIP-relative LEA or direct immediate MOV string argument followed by a direct CALL or tail JMP through a code-cave bridge; the bridge uses stack-pointer adjustment, byte stores, immediate XOR/ADD byte decoding, and optional NOP interleaving. self-modifying-code-instruction-catalogu.preconditions: Input-specific preconditions are documented by the implementation and may reject the sample.
self-modifying-code-instruction-catalogu.invariants: Structural validity is required; complete runtime parity is not yet established for every path.
self-modifying-code-instruction-catalogu.instructions_affected: Eligible non-entry straight-line x86/x86-64 functions of at least 16 bytes, without calls, jumps, syscalls, or RIP-relative operands, keep their first five bytes as a saved prologue, XOR-encrypt the remaining body in place, and replace the entry with a rel32 JMP to a cave stub. The stub preserves the caller-saved register set, issues mprotect, restores the saved prologue with byte stores, XOR-decrypts func+5..end via a byte loop, restores registers, and jumps back to the function entry.
self-modifying-code-instruction-catalogu.performance: Measured by the scheduled extended maturity pass smoke: output-size, transform-duration, runtime-duration, and static metric summaries are recorded for every selected pass.
self-modifying-code-instruction-catalogu.compatibility: Composition with other passes is not contractually supported.
